findings.detail: The extracted maturity_date is 2024-10-31, but the matching source row states due 10/2029, implying 2029-10-31.

rationale: Class 2 row-level adjudication: the flagged row is Price Fx Inc. with EUR 910 par, initial acquisition date 12/19/2024, E + 6.25%, interest rate 9.12%, cost 921, and fair value 919. The raw schedule row with those same attributes states the loan is due 10/2029, while the extracted holding stored maturity_date as 2024-10-31. The flag is therefore a real extraction error in maturity_date, not merely a valid matured position warning.
